en.title: Put a face to the work.
en.description: Give the steps in your creative workflow a role: make the brief clear, build in your tools, check the result, and pass it on.
en.reduced: Animation paused by your motion preference

roles.name: The planner
roles.purpose: Turn a broad idea into a small, clear task.
roles.task: Plan a product turntable: one model, a neutral background, and a short list of shots to review.

roles.name: The maker
roles.purpose: Build and adjust the scene in your creative tools.
roles.task: Create a simple scene in Blender, keep the objects editable, and save the project for review.

roles.name: The look artist
roles.purpose: Work on materials, lighting, and the final look.
roles.task: Try a soft studio light and two material options. Keep both versions so I can compare them.

roles.name: The reviewer
roles.purpose: Check the result against the original request.
roles.task: Check the saved scene, camera framing, and render output. Tell me what still needs attention.

roles.name: The producer
roles.purpose: Hand over files someone else can pick up.
roles.task: Collect the editable project, preview, and a short note explaining how to open and continue the work.

zh.title: 给每一份工作，一张熟悉的面孔。
zh.description: 用角色组织自己的创作流程：说清需求，在软件里制作，检查结果，再把成果交给下一位。
zh.reduced: 已按系统偏好暂停动画
zh.taskLabel: 可以这样交代一个任务

roles.name: 任务规划
roles.purpose: 把宽泛的想法，整理成一件说得清的小事。
roles.task: 帮我规划一段产品转台：一个模型、干净的背景，再列出需要检查的几个镜头。

roles.name: 场景制作
roles.purpose: 在熟悉的创作软件里，搭建和调整场景。
roles.task: 在 Blender 里搭一个简单场景，保留可编辑的物体，保存工程供我检查。

roles.name: 材质灯光
roles.purpose: 尝试材质、灯光和画面的整体感觉。
roles.task: 试一组柔和的棚拍灯光，做两种材质方案，保留两个版本让我比较。

roles.name: 结果检查
roles.purpose: 对照最初的要求，看成果还缺什么。
roles.task: 检查保存的工程、镜头构图和渲染文件，把还需要处理的地方告诉我。

roles.name: 成果交付
roles.purpose: 整理好文件，让别人能顺手接着做。
roles.task: 把可编辑工程、预览图和简短说明放在一起，告诉下一位怎么打开、从哪里继续。
